host.note: Standard-kernel QEMU VM exposes /sys/devices/system/node/node0 + hugepages sysfs (unlike OrbStack VMs). x86_64 is TCG-emulated under arm64 — no KVM, too slow for slot cadence.

target.deviation_note: 5 GCC-12 cast conversions + 1 NUMA-fabrication fallback in fd_numa_linux.c. Source-deviation build, NOT clean upstream.

goal: Determine the highest honest evidence level reachable for Frankendancer on a standard-kernel QEMU x86_64 VM (NUMA + hugepages available, but TCG/no-KVM).
method: Boot Ubuntu 24.04 x86_64 VM under QEMU TCG (q35,accel=tcg,-cpu max,-smp 16,-m 65536).
fdctl configure init hugetlbfs  -> reserves 19969 hugepages, mounts hugetlbfs at /mnt/.fd.
fdctl configure init sysctl + configure check all  -> exit 0.
fdctl keys new  -> creates identity.json (pre-existing, preserved).
fdctl run  with bootstrap=true, sandbox=false, only_known=false, snapshot/genesis/poh disabled, hashes_per_tick=1.
180s timeout; full untruncated output + dmesg captured.
evidence_level_rationale: The embedded Agave validator (fd_ext_validator_main) booted, parsed all argv via clap (clap accepted argv), initialized its ledger subsystem (created ledger dir: accounts/, admin.rpc, ledger.lock, snapshots/), reached genesis-config load, and stayed alive until killed by the 180s timeout (SIGTERM). The metric tile initialized and served Prometheus on 127.0.0.1:7999. This is process liveness WITH machine-readable init-progress evidence, not liveness alone.
key_observations: configure init hugetlbfs exit=0 (19969 hugepages reserved, hugetlbfs mounted) — the NUMA/hugepage gate PASSES on the standard-kernel VM.
fd_bootinfo.c(161): booting validator fdvm version 0.101.40300 pid 1029 with 14 tiles and 39 GiB memory.
fd_metric_tile.c(148): prometheus server listening at http://127.0.0.1:7999/metrics — metric tile alive.
run_agave.c(239): booting agave pid:1033 — embedded Agave subprocess spawned.
cli.rs(277): --limit-ledger-size is deprecated — clap ACCEPTED argv (the fd-start24 clap blocker is FIXED).
execute.rs(1002): --vote-account not specified, validator will not vote.
open.rs(25): Failed to load genesis_config ... genesis.bin ... NotFound. Will attempt to unpack genesis archive and then retry loading. — Agave reached genesis-load with no genesis.bin.
run.c(91): Received signal SIGTERM — killed by the 180s timeout, NOT a crash.
Ledger dir created during run: accounts/, admin.rpc, ledger.lock, snapshots/ — proves Agave initialized its ledger subsystem.

blockers_resolved.root_cause: waker:0 and metric:0 tiles killed by SECCOMP_RET_KILL_PROCESS for clock_nanosleep (syscall 228); the waker tile seccomp policy allows only write/fsync/epoll_pwait. AppArmor also DENIED CAP_SYS_ADMIN for the sandbox's userns_create.
blockers_resolved.evidence: dmesg audit type=1326 (AUDIT_SECCOMP) sig=31 syscall=228 code=0x80000000 on comm=waker:0 and comm=metric:0 (console-start23.txt).
blockers_resolved.fix: development.sandbox=false in fd-vm.toml — config-only toggle (fd_config_parse.c:319), skips fd_sandbox_enter (seccomp + CLONE_NEWUSER) and CLONE_NEWPID (run.c:721, run_agave.c:256). NOT a source deviation.

blockers_resolved.root_cause: default.toml sets rpc.only_known=true, so agave_boot (run_agave.c:144) emits --only-known-rpc. That clap arg has .requires("known_validators") (rpc_bootstrap_config.rs:87); with an empty known_validators list (bootstrap dev node, no trusted peers), clap demands --known-validator and prints usage.
blockers_resolved.evidence: console-start24.txt: 'error: The following required arguments were not provided: --known-validator' before the usage line.
blockers_resolved.fix: [rpc] only_known=false in fd-vm.toml — config-only toggle (run_agave.c:144), NOT a source deviation.

remaining_gap_to_joined: The image's fdctl has no genesis subcommand (only fddev does, and fddev is not in this image). There is no solana-genesis binary. The prior Jito/Agave genesis-creating images (solana-diff/jito-solana:4.3.0-jito-arm64) were cleaned up to reclaim disk and are no longer available locally. Without a genesis.bin, the embedded Agave cannot complete genesis load, so it cannot join/gossip/vote. Building solana-genesis from the agave submodule would require a multi-hour Rust cross-compile under emulation with host disk already at 87%.
limits_of_this_result: TCG (x86_64-on-arm64, no KVM) is too slow for slot cadence; voting was never expected and was not reached.
sandbox=false is a research-grade relaxation, NOT a production or voting-validator config.
This is Frankendancer (fdctl+embedded Agave), NOT full Firedancer. Per AGENTS.md, Frankendancer reuses Agave execution/consensus and is not an independent SVM oracle.
6 tracked source-deviation files remain (5 GCC-12 casts + 1 NUMA fallback); this is a source-deviation build, not a clean upstream build.
The metric tile + Agave child staying alive until timeout is started-evidence, not joined/voting/end-to-end evidence.
No genesis.bin was produced or loaded; genesis load was not completed.

cleanup_state: No QEMU process or container left running. qcow2 and built image retained. identity.json preserved in qcow2.
